data.narrative:
Kepler Communications, a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $200M+, is valued here through triangulation against a peer universe of 5 public comparables and 8 private peers operating in the same sector.

Two valuation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis, using the $200M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $340M. Peer-median analysis references three same-stage, same-sector private companies: Sierra Space ($8.0B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B), and Skyryse ($1.1B). The median of this peer set is $1.5B, though the range spans $1.1B to $8.0B, reflecting material dispersion. Public-comp anchoring using the 5-ticker Space & Aerospace median P/S multiple of 26.4x cannot be applied due to the absence of target revenue data, typical for private companies at this stage.

Triangulating the two applicable methods yields a valuation range of $289M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $920M. The wide spread reflects uncertainty around where Kepler positions within its peer cohort by revenue traction and market opportunity. Key sensitivities include revenue trajectory relative to comparables and the binary risk of commercialization success in satellite operations.
